ambient-take-your-pick.use_when: Long-form reflective or contemplative pieces; a wide, unobtrusive bed.
ambient-take-your-pick.avoid_when: Anything with a punchy intro or a clear climax you do not want underneath the voice.
ambient-take-your-pick.note: Very low dynamics (flat master) - sits predictably under narration.

cheerful-moments-nekzlo.use_when: Light, friendly explainers and onboarding-style walkthroughs.
cheerful-moments-nekzlo.note: Quietest of the upbeat set - will sit noticeably lower than happy-rainbow under the same bed level.

cheerful-smile-ikson.use_when: Optimistic progress/announcement videos; upbeat without being frantic.

chill-slow-times-over-here.use_when: Slow-burn, thoughtful, long runtime (>=280s) - rare in this library, so it usually does NOT need looping.
chill-slow-times-over-here.avoid_when: Short cutdowns; you will trim most of it.

classical-gymnopedie-no-3.use_when: Quiet, reflective, philosophical or historical narration; sparse enough to leave room for the voice.
classical-gymnopedie-no-3.note: Quiet master and wide dynamics - may need its bed level raised to stay audible.

dance-wild-pogo.use_when: Rhythmic, energetic montages and upbeat explainers with movement.
dance-wild-pogo.note: Flat, loud master - stays steady under the voice.

electronic-nekozilla.avoid_when: Anything needing a quiet, unobtrusive bed.
electronic-nekozilla.note: Widest dynamics in the library - expect the mix to swell and compete with narration.

emotional-past-life.avoid_when: Anything long - this is the shortest track (117s) and will loop several times.

happy-rainbow.use_when: Bright, celebratory, upbeat conclusions and community-facing content.

kids-twinkle-twinkle.note: Quietest master in the library - inaudible at the default bed level without raising it.

light-gravity.use_when: Default choice for light, breezy technical explainers - loud master keeps it audible under narration.
light-gravity.note: Loudest master in the library: if it feels pushy, lower the bed rather than discarding it.

peaceful-sleeping-sheep.use_when: Calm, meditative, ambient backgrounds; long runtime so no looping needed.

rock-not-the-only-one.use_when: Guitar-driven pieces needing forward momentum and emotional lift.
rock-not-the-only-one.avoid_when: Quiet, contemplative writing - a rock bed under a whisper is wrong.
rock-not-the-only-one.note: Flattest and loudest master; will dominate unless attenuated hard.

upbeat-your-love.use_when: Forward-moving tech explainers and 'the paradigm is changing' narratives; the build-and-drop arc suits a thesis stated early.
upbeat-your-love.avoid_when: Somber material - this is an uplifting major-key track.
upbeat-your-love.note: Does not resolve at the end; when it loops the seam is audible, so prefer it when the runtime divides cleanly or accept the loop point under narration.

epic-the-epic-hero.use_when: Opening beats and high-stakes reveals - an orchestral piano build that announces a turn.
epic-the-epic-hero.avoid_when: Sombre or quiet material; this is a confident, forward-moving trailer cue.

epic-phoenix.use_when: Long-form epic arcs - a battle, a rise to power, a crescendo across five minutes or more.
epic-phoenix.avoid_when: Dense explanatory narration; 19.7 LU of range means the bed swells hard in the gaps.
epic-phoenix.note: Longest new track and one of the widest dynamic ranges in the library - mix with care.

trailer-silhouette-of-war.use_when: Conflict, rivalry and standoff scenes that need trailer-grade tension.
trailer-silhouette-of-war.avoid_when: Calm explainers; the percussion fights the voice.

sad-lonesome-journey.use_when: Melancholy passages - loss, exile, a slow goodbye.
sad-lonesome-journey.avoid_when: Anything that needs an audible bed; at -21 LUFS it sits far under the narration.
sad-lonesome-journey.note: Quietest master in the library - inaudible at the default bed level without raising it.

sad-undertow.use_when: Quiet sad-piano beds - regret, consequence, slow reflection.
sad-undertow.avoid_when: Dense information-heavy narration; 11 LU of range swells under the voice.
sad-undertow.note: Quiet master with wide dynamics - raise the bed level before judging it.

dramatic-this-too-shall-pass.use_when: Long dramatic builds - the peak of an argument, or the weight of a decision landing.
dramatic-this-too-shall-pass.avoid_when: Plain explainers; too much movement under a calm voice.

dark-shattered-glass.use_when: Mystery and investigation - a revelation the audience should feel.

suspense-faith.use_when: Spy-thriller tension and slow-burn suspense beats.
suspense-faith.note: Shortest of the tension set (157s) - the loop point returns to the pulse.

chinese-lau-tzu-ehru.use_when: Chinese historical or period scenes - erhu under court, journey and battle narration.
chinese-lau-tzu-ehru.avoid_when: Contemporary tech explainers; the timbre reads as period, not modern.
chinese-lau-tzu-ehru.note: Shortest new track (102s) and a quiet master - it loops often and sits low; raise the bed.

japanese-yugen.use_when: A quiet Japanese interlude - the calm between two scenes.
japanese-yugen.avoid_when: Anything that needs an audible bed; at -22 LUFS it nearly disappears.

hopeful-resolutions.use_when: Turnarounds and resolutions - the part of the story where things improve.
hopeful-resolutions.avoid_when: Tense or tragic passages; the major-key lift undercuts them.

romantic-white-petals.use_when: Tender, intimate moments - letters, memory, affection.
romantic-white-petals.avoid_when: Anything energetic; also quiet enough to need a raised bed.

war-endless-storm.use_when: Open conflict - an army, a siege, a standoff that has already started.
war-endless-storm.avoid_when: Anything quiet; at -7.3 LUFS this is the loudest master in the library and will dominate.
war-endless-storm.note: Loudest master in the library - attenuate hard or it swamps the narration.

samurai-a-just-ronin.use_when: Long samurai or duel sequences - a ronin's vigil, a walk to the last stand.
samurai-a-just-ronin.avoid_when: Dense text; 21.6 LU is the widest dynamic range in the library.
samurai-a-just-ronin.note: Widest dynamics in the library - the bed breathes hard between phrases.

medieval-adventure-beyond.use_when: Journey and quest narratives - a caravan, a voyage, an expedition.

corporate-synesthesia.use_when: Business, product and analytics explainers; a polished, modern bed.

lofi-herbal-tea.use_when: Study or reading content, and a low-energy explanatory pace.
lofi-herbal-tea.avoid_when: Anything needing a clear beat or a lift - 17.5 LU of range means it drifts.
lofi-herbal-tea.note: Wide dynamics for a lo-fi bed - it drops a lot between phrases.

inspiring-flowing-energy.use_when: Forward motion - a build, a turning point, a scale-up.
inspiring-flowing-energy.avoid_when: Somber material; a loud, bright master.
inspiring-flowing-energy.note: Loud master (-8.5 LUFS) - lower the bed rather than discarding it.
